notes: W4-4 guard (CR 603.10a, 704.5d). Basri's Lieutenant: 'Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, if it had a +1/+1 counter on it, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.' A Soldier TOKEN with one +1/+1 counter dies to 2 damage. State-based actions run before the trigger is put on the stack, and a token in the graveyard ceases to exist as one of them (CR 117.5). The Lieutenant's trigger reads the token's last known information (CR 603.4, 608.2h): it had the counter, so it makes a Knight. Re-noted 2026-11-17: the engine no longer keeps the token while its triggers wait (BACKLOG B-112, closed).
